# RoyaleCoach AI

RoyaleCoach AI is an independent AI-powered companion app for Clash Royale players. It is owned and operated by Veltrix LLC, a Wyoming limited liability company.

RoyaleCoach AI helps players with deck analysis, deck building, meta deck discovery, battle learning, player statistics, upgrade priorities, and strategy recommendations.
